text: In the Pacific Northwest in 1983, the lumberjack Red Miller lives with Mandy Bloom, an artist who works a gas station till by day. When Mandy catches the eye of Jeremiah Sand, leader of the Children of the New Dawn, his followers [summon the Black Skulls|origin|deliberately called up], a demonic biker gang, to seize her. She laughs at Sand, and [he burns her alive before Red|wrong|a life taken], leaving him to forge a battle axe and [hunt the cult through a hallucinatory landscape|wants|revenge for a wrong] to their [wooden church in a quarry|images|buildings and public places].
